blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.
blocks.zh: 视觉无障碍代理和机器人等应用需要快速地通过一个被限定的过去帧(如后两分钟)的窗口回答关于最近视频内容的问题. 混合视觉语言模型(VLMs)与Gated DeltaNet(GDN)等线性反复层相接而来,对这个设置具有吸引力,但保持一个滑动窗口却很昂贵. 原因是再生地层将所有过去的帧合并为一个共享状态,所以过期的旧帧通常需要通过模型重新运行整个窗口. 我们观察到,反复更新在状态下是带有投入依赖系数的同源物,因此可以捕捉到每个帧的效果,作为共成的转变. 我们提出Spool,一个免费的训练框架,它可以缓存每帧状态变换,并在窗口推进时高效地作曲,从每个经常层状态去掉过期的帧而无需通过主干重放帧. 每个层内部的清除是准确的;与注意钥匙价值的清除一样,过期的框架可以通过由更上一层计算出的缓存投入保留剩余影响。 我们设计了专用数据结构和GPU内核,以实现低缓存和高成份. 通过5个开源混合VLM和4个视频推理基准,斯普尔在所有20个模型基准测试中实现了最低的p95时间对先入为主,比最近的2个vLLM基线更快的几何平均值减少6.6\times$,同时将精度平均提高2.3个百分点.

blocks.en: In streaming video understanding, a vision-language model (VLM) continuously ingests video frames and answers user prompts in real time. Consider the example where a robot receives a request and reasons through successive actions using its camera. Responses must be fast and accurate because the environment changes rapidly, new frames arrive continually, and poor visual perception leads to inaccurate actions. Other applications include visual accessibility agents Zhang et al. (2025) , medical video understanding Su et al. (2026) , interactive live sports analytics Chen et al. (2025a) ; Xu et al. (2026) , streaming content moderation Yew et al. (2026) , and industrial and manufacturing applications Zhuge et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 在流媒体视频理解中,一个视觉语言模型(VLM)持续地摄取视频帧并实时回答用户提示. 考虑机器人通过连续动作使用相机接收请求和理由的例子. 反应必须迅速和准确,因为环境变化迅速,新框架不断到来,视力差导致行动不准确。 其他应用包括视觉无障碍代理Zhang等人(2025年),医学视频理解Su等人(2026年),交互式现场体育分析. Chen等人(2025a);徐等人(2026),流体内容节制 Yew等人(2026年),以及工业和制造业应用 诸葛等(2026).

blocks.en: The key challenge is that these models (e.g., Qwen3.5-VL Qwen Team (2026) , Nemotron 3.5 Super VL NVIDIA (2026) ) incur computational cost for every new frame and eventually reach the model’s maximum context length. Streaming systems therefore maintain a sliding window: they keep the video’s last N N frames and evict older ones (e.g., with N = 60 N=60 , frame 1 1 is evicted when frame 61 61 arrives). Serving engines such as vLLM Kwon et al. (2023) and SGLang Zheng et al. (2024) reuse computation across requests through prefix caching. However, prefix caching requires the beginning of the sequence to remain unchanged. Once the window evicts the first frame, the cache is invalidated, forcing recomputation of every remaining frame (e.g., frames 2 through 61).
blocks.zh: 关键的挑战在于这些模型(如Quen3.5-VL Quen Team(2026),Nemotron 3.5 Super VL NVIDIA(2026))会为每个新帧产生计算成本,并最终达到模型的最大上下文长度. 因此,流线系统维持一个滑动窗口:它们保留了视频最后的N帧并驱逐了旧的(例如,N=60N=60,当帧61到达时,帧1被驱逐). 提供VLLM Kwon等人(2023年)和SGLang Zheng等人(2024年)等引擎,通过前缀钉进行重复利用计算。 然而,前缀的凸起要求序列的开始保持不变. 一旦窗口驱逐了第一个帧,缓存就会失效,迫使每个剩余帧(如帧2至61)重算.

blocks.en: Attention layers can avoid this recomputation by evicting the key-value (KV) entries of expired frames directly. Hybrid VLMs, however, make the problem more difficult. They interleave two types of layers (Fig. 2 ): attention layers, which store per-token KV entries for retrieving past information, and linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) Yang et al. (2025) , which mix successive frames into a single fixed-size state. KV entries can be evicted individually, but the recurrent state has no per-frame entries to remove. For queries restricted to the current window, expired frames should no longer affect the answer, yet their influence persists in the recurrent state after the corresponding KV entries are evicted. Removing it normally requires re-running the entire window through the model, a slow process.
blocks.zh: 注意层可以通过直接驱逐过期帧的密钥值(KV)条目来避免这种重算. 然而,VLM混合型地雷使问题变得更加困难。 它们互换了两种类型的层(图2): 注意层,用于存储每盘KV条目以获取过去的信息; 线性重复层,如Gated DeltaNet(GDN) Yang et al. (2025),将相继的帧组合为一个固定大小的状态. KV条目可以被单独拆卸,但经常状态没有每个框架条目可以删除. 对于限于当前窗口的查询,过期帧不应再影响答案,然而在相应的KV条目被移除后,其影响持续在反复状态. 删除它通常需要通过模型重新运行整个窗口,这是一个缓慢的过程.

blocks.en: To address this problem, we introduce Spool . Our key insight is that, with no additional training, we can cache how each video frame transforms the recurrent state, and reuse these transformations as the window advances . This lets Spool both incorporate new frames and remove the influence of expired frames without re-running the window.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们介绍Spool。 我们的关键见解是,如果没有额外的训练,我们可以缓存每个视频帧如何改变反复出现的状况,然后随着窗口的推进而重新使用这些转变。 这使得Spool既可以包含新的帧,又可以去除过期帧的影响而不重新运行窗口.

blocks.en: Spool addresses three challenges.
blocks.zh: 斯波尔应对三个挑战.

blocks.en: Challenge 1: Removing expired frames from recurrent state. Unlike attention, which keeps a memory entry per token, a recurrent layer keeps a fixed-size state that every new frame updates (Fig. 1 ). Conventional state checkpointing (i.e., storing the GDN state after every frame) does not help, because each checkpoint already contains information from earlier frames that should expire. Our observation is that a GDN (or Mamba) update is an affine transformation of the previous state , S t = S t − 1 ​ A t + B t S_{t}=S_{t-1}A_{t}+B_{t} , so the updates for all tokens in a frame compose into a single affine transformation. Rather than caching states, Spool caches the multiplicative and additive coefficients ( A , B ) (A,B) of each frame’s transformation. Composing the coefficients of the frames in the current window and applying the result to the initial state rebuilds each recurrent layer’s state without re-running the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; expired frames retain residual influence only through the inputs that earlier layers computed while those frames were in context, as with KV eviction in attention. We show in § 5 that this residual effect has little impact on accuracy, and that caching the coefficients requires only a modest amount of extra memory (4.8 GiB, or 18%, for a 9B model).

Applying the cached transformation of every frame in the window takes O ⁡ ( W ) O(W) work per update, where W W is the window length in frames. Because affine transformations compose associatively, Spool caches the combined transformations of consecutive frames in a segment tree and reconstructs the state with O ⁡ ( log ⁡ W ) O(\log W) compositions.

blocks.en: Challenge 3: Reclaiming attention memory. Unlike the recurrent state, attention KV entries can be removed individually. However, serving engines store the KV cache in fixed-size pages. Evicting early frames leaves partially occupied pages, and compacting the surviving entries would require copying memory proportional to the retained context. Spool instead fills vacated KV slots with the entries of newly arriving frames. To prevent positional indices from growing indefinitely, Spool periodically rebases cached rotary position embeddings (RoPE), preserving relative-position attention without recomputing visual representations.

blocks.en: We evaluate Spool on six open-source hybrid VLMs, from 0.8B to 122B parameters with GDN and Mamba-2 recurrent layers, and four streaming video benchmarks, against vLLM-Omni with and without its recently added incremental prefill. In online serving, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model–benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of 6.6 × 6.6\times (up to 35.7 × 35.7\times ) over the faster baseline and 33.8 × 33.8\times over vLLM-Omni, keeping p95 under 1 s in 16 of 20 model–benchmark tests compared with 3 for incremental prefill. Because fewer questions are dropped under streaming load, it also improves online accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average and by up to 18.4 points on Beyond3D. Without timing pressure, Spool stays within − 1.6 -1.6 to + 1.8 +1.8 points of the more accurate baseline in all 24 offline tests. Its caching components reduce per-frame ingestion latency by 7–17% relative to a naive cache, KV filling saves up to 1.8 GiB of peak memory, and after 1024 expired frames, state reconstruction keeps KL divergence from vLLM-Omni about 2.5 × 2.5\times lower than without it.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Motivation
blocks.zh: 2 背景和动机

blocks.en: 2.1 VLMs for Realtime Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 实时视频理解的VLM

blocks.en: VLMs combine visual perception with language understanding, allowing users to ask natural language questions about images and video. For video, they can reason across frames about events and how a scene changes over time.
blocks.zh: VLM将视觉感知与语言理解相结合,允许用户询问关于图像和视频的自然语言问题. 对于视频,他们可以跨帧解释事件,以及一个场景如何随时间变化.

blocks.en: Streaming applications (§ 1 ) impose three requirements. First, answers must arrive promptly and reflect recent observations; second, processing must keep pace with incoming frames; and third, services handling many concurrent streams need high throughput at low cost. These requirements are hard to meet because every frame requires visual encoding and language model computation.
blocks.zh: 流程应用程序(第1节)规定了三项要求。 第一,答复必须迅速提出并反映最近的意见;第二,处理工作必须跟上收到的框架;第三,处理许多并行流程的服务需要低成本的高吞吐量。 这些要求难以满足,因为每个帧都需要视觉编码和语言模型计算.

blocks.en: A streaming VLM processes frames incrementally and retains model state to reuse earlier computation. When a question arrives, it generates an answer from the accumulated video context and the question. To operate within finite resources on long-running streams, the system keeps a sliding window of recent frames, in which older frames expire as new ones arrive. This workflow involves three operations: video updates, question answering, and maintaining the state for the active window.
blocks.zh: 一个流式的VLM进程框架递增,并保留模型状态以重复早期的计算. 当一个问题到达时,它从累积的视频上下文和问题中产生一个答案. 为了在有限的资源范围内在长期流上运作,该系统保持了最近帧的滑动窗口,其中旧帧随着新帧的到来而到期。 这个工作流程涉及三个操作:视频更新,提问回答,以及维护活动窗口的状态.

blocks.en: 2.2 Hybrid VLM Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.2 混合VLM 建筑

blocks.en: Figure 2: Architecture of the hybrid VLM. Multiple input frames are converted into visual tokens by a vision encoder and passed alongside text tokens into a unified backbone. This backbone interleaves recurrent layers, which update a fixed-size state for each token, with attention layers, which retain per-token key–value entries.
blocks.zh: 图2:混合VLM结构. 多个输入框通过视觉编码器转换成视觉符号,并随文字符号一起传递成统一的骨干. 此主干线互换层,用于更新每个令牌的固定大小状态,并带有注意层,保留每个按键的值条目。

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates the architecture of a hybrid VLM. A vision encoder converts each incoming frame into a sequence of visual tokens, and instructions and questions are embedded as text tokens. The language backbone processes the combined sequence causally and generates answer tokens autoregressively.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了混合VLM的结构. 一个视觉编码器将每个传入的帧转换成一系列视觉符号,指令和问题被嵌入为文本符号. 语言骨干会因果地处理组合序列,并自动生成答案符号.

blocks.en: The backbone interleaves two types of sequence-mixing layers that differ in how they represent history: attention layers retain separate entries for earlier tokens, while recurrent layers summarize history in a fixed-size state.
blocks.zh: 骨干间断层分两类序列混合层,它们代表历史的方式不同: 注意层为早期的令牌保留单独的条目,而经常层则以固定大小的状态总结历史.

blocks.en: Attention layers. An attention layer accesses preceding tokens through their key and value vectors, which are retained in a KV cache during inference. New tokens reuse these cached entries to compute attention outputs. The cache preserves separately addressable entries for individual tokens, allowing the model to precisely retrieve specific pieces of past information, though the required memory size increases directly with the length of the context Kwon et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 注意层 注意层通过它们的密钥和值向量访问前的符号,在推论时会保留在KV缓存中. 新令牌重新使用这些缓存的条目来计算注意输出. 缓存保存了单个令牌的可单独地址的条目,使模型能够精确地检索过去信息的特定片段,尽管所需的内存大小随着上下文Kwon et al. (2023)的长度而直接增加.

blocks.en: Recurrent layers. Recurrent layers, including Mamba-style state-space layers and Gated DeltaNet (GDN), accumulate history in a fixed-size state. This allows them to process long sequence lengths by completely decoupling memory consumption from the amount of context observed. They help a model maintain a persistent summary of past information Gu & Dao (2023) ; Dao & Gu (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: 2.3 KV Cache Management
blocks.zh: 2.3 车辆 快取管理

blocks.en: The KV cache grows as new tokens are processed. Paged attention divides its storage into fixed-size chunks of GPU memory, called pages , each with space for a fixed number of tokens’ key–value pairs Kwon et al. (2023) . A sequence of tokens/blocks/frame entries can span multiple pages, which need not be adjacent in memory. A page table records which page holds each consecutive group of entries, and the attention computation consults this table to find the keys and values it needs. The cache can therefore grow by allocating additional pages as needed.
blocks.zh: KV 缓存随着新令牌的处理而增长. 页面注意将其存储分为固定大小的 GPU 内存, 称为页面, 每页都有固定数个符号的密钥 - 值对的空间 Kwon等人(2023年). 一系列的令牌/块/框条目可以跨越多个页面,在内存中不需要相邻. 页面表记录了每组连续的条目,注意的计算可参考本表查找所需的密钥和值。 因此,缓存可以通过根据需要分配额外页面而增加。

blocks.en: Because frames produce variable numbers of tokens, frame boundaries often fall across KV pages. As a simple example, consider a page of four token entries, where the first six tokens belong to expired frames. Evicting these tokens frees the first page (tokens 1–4), but the second page must retain tokens 7–8. This leaves two invalid entries (tokens 5–6) alongside live entries in the same page. These holes cannot be reclaimed by freeing the page and must be excluded from attention.

blocks.en: A token’s logical position identifies where it occurs in the input sequence; its storage location identifies where its KV entry resides in memory. An attention layer compares a new token’s query vector with cached keys to compute weights for a weighted sum of their associated values. Rotary position embeddings (RoPE) encode token positions by rotating query and key vectors according to position indices Su et al. (2021) . The resulting attention scores depend on relative position differences. Since keys are cached after rotation, each stored key already carries position information. Evicting old tokens reduces the number of cached entries, but does not automatically reset the positions assigned to subsequent tokens.

blocks.en: 2.4 Context Window Maintenance

blocks.en: Streaming VLMs continuously process a live stream of video blocks while answering intermittent user questions. Each block contains multiple contiguous frames, and each frame can produce a different number of visual tokens. To respect the model’s context limit, the system maintains a fixed prefix (e.g., the system prompt) followed by a sliding window of recent video blocks. The window is constrained by both frame and token budgets, with tokens reserved for questions and generated responses.

blocks.en: Recent approaches like vLLM-Omni’s incremental-prefill strategy vLLM-Omni Contributors (2025) work by reducing the rebuild frequency by evicting in batches rather than advancing the window one block at a time. In our evaluated configuration, it discards the oldest half of the window when capacity is reached. This approach has three limitations: (1) full rebuilds still cause tail-latency spikes; (2) batch eviction discards potentially useful context that could otherwise remain within the budget; and (3) reserving capacity for batch eviction prevents continuous use of the full context budget.

blocks.en: This highlights an opportunity to eliminate redundancy by reusing the cached states of retained blocks. The central challenge, however, is reusing these states while effectively removing the influence of blocks no longer in the active context.

blocks.en: 3 Design
blocks.zh: 3 设计

blocks.en: Spool is a training-free inference engine that efficiently maintains a bounded video context window for VLMs. Spool centers around using internal state of previously processed processed frames. In particular, Spool has two complementary mechanisms: (1) recurrent state reconstruction , which caches transformations of previously processed video blocks to maintain accurate recurrent state, and (2) attention cache reclamation , which minimizes data movement for expiring KV entries.
blocks.zh: Spool是一个无训练的推论引擎,它有效维护了VLMs的限定视频上下文窗口. 使用以前处理过的帧的内部状态来进行拼接。 特别是,Spool有两种互补机制: (1)经常性状态重建,它缓存了先前处理过的视频块的变换,以保持准确的经常性状态; (2)注意力缓存开垦,它最大限度地减少了过期的KV条目的数据运动.

blocks.en: We first describe Spool’s execution model (§ 3.1 ), followed by recurrent state reconstruction (§ 3.1 ), its efficient implementation (§ 3.3 ), and attention cache reclamation (§ 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先描述了Spool的执行模式(第3.1节),然后是经常性的国家重建(第3.1节),其有效实施(第3.3节)和注意力缓存回收(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Streaming Execution Model
blocks.zh: 3.1 流化执行模式

blocks.en: Active Window. Spool represents the active video window as a block range [ a , b ) [a,b) . When admitting a new block that would exceed either budget, the engine solely advances a a to evict the oldest blocks. Eviction always occurs at whole-block boundaries, even though individual blocks can contain different numbers of frames and tokens. Once a video is at the set context length budget, all future frames will mantain the same length through eviction.
blocks.zh: 活动窗口。 Spool代表活动视频窗口作为块范围[a,b] [a,b]. 当接受一个超过预算的任何预算的新区块时,引擎只推进一个驱逐最古老区块的程序。 排解总是发生在整块边界,尽管单个块可以包含不同数量的帧和符. 一旦一个视频出现在设定的上下文长度预算上,所有未来框架都会通过驱逐达到相同的长度.

blocks.en: Session State. The engine prefills the fixed system prompt once and saves its recurrent state as an anchor for subsequent reconstruction. The engine then maintains three types of model state: (1) recurrent states, (2) cached recurrent transformations, and (3) attention KV pages. The engine additionally tracks metadata including token identities, block boundaries, and positions to keep the internal data consistent with the main active window.
blocks.zh: 众会州. 引擎预装固定系统一次并保存其反复状态作为后续重建的锚. 之后,引擎维持了三种类型的模型状态:(1)经常性状态,(2)缓存的经常性变换,(3)注意KV页. 引擎额外跟踪元数据,包括令牌身份,块边界,和位置,以保持内部数据与主活动窗口一致.

blocks.en: Video Block Updates. When a new video block arrives, the engine first determines which existing blocks must expire. If eviction is necessary, it removes the expired blocks’ KV entries and reconstructs the recurrent state of the retained window using the stored block transitions, as described in § 3.2 and § 3.4 . The engine then prefills the incoming block, records its recurrent transition, and updates the segment tree. If no eviction is required, prefill continues directly from the live state. In either case, the engine updates the context window without reprocessing the retained video tokens, leaving it ready for the next block or question.
blocks.zh: 视频块更新. 当一个新的视频块到达时,引擎首先确定哪些现有块必须过期. 如果驱逐是必要的,它会删除过期的块的 KV 条目,并利用存储的块过渡重建保留窗口的经常状态,如第3.2和第3.4节所述。 引擎随后预先填充进站块,记录其反复过渡,并更新段树. 如果不需要驱逐,则直接从生活状态进行预填。 无论是哪种情况,引擎都更新了上下文窗口,而不后处理保留下来的视频符号,将其留给下一个块或问题。

As the inputs to the GDN (the keys, values, and gates in Eq. 2 ) are held fixed, each cached pair ( A i , B i ) (A_{i},B_{i}) exactly represents the updates in block i i to any layer’s recurrent state. Replaying the retained transitions from the layer’s prefix anchor S p S_{\mathrm{p}} therefore yields the same state as executing those recorded updates as the default process.
blocks.zh: 在每一个经常层中,过渡缓存和重播对于记录的状态更新是无损失的. 随着对 GDN 的输入( Eq. 2 中的密钥、 值和门) 被固定, 每个缓存对( A i, B i) (A_{i}, B_{i}) 完全代表了 i 区中的更新到任何层的常态 。 重放该层前缀主播S p S_{\ mathrm{p}}} 的保存的转换结果, 因此输出的状态与执行记录的更新时的默认过程相同 。

blocks.en: However, this layerwise exactness does not imply equivalence to rerunning the full network. In a multilayer network, the input features to a given recurrent layer are produced by preceding layers and may already reflect blocks that have since expired. Consequently, the recorded coefficients A i A_{i} and B i B_{i} can depend on the history present when block i i was originally processed. Omitting expired transitions therefore removes their direct contributions to a given layer, but does not eliminate their influence already encoded in the retained transitions. As we show in § 5 and Appendix C , relative to full-network recomputation, Spool introduces only a small, bounded approximation error that does not accumulate as the window advances.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种层层精确性并不意味着对等重排整个网络. 在多层网络中,给定的经常性层的输入特性由前层产生,可能已经反映自此过期的块. 因此,记录的系数A i A_{i}和B i B_{i}可以取决于I区最初处理时的历史。 因此,Omitting 过期的过渡会消除其对某一层的直接贡献,但不会消除其在保留过渡中已经编码的影响力. 正如我们在§5和附录C中所示,相对于全网络重算,Spool只引入了一个小的,有界限的近似错误,不会随着窗口的推进而累积.

blocks.en: Residual summary representation. To limit the memory overhead of caching block transition matrices, Spool uses bfloat16 by default. However, A A is often close to the identity matrix (see Eq. 2 ), so directly storing it in low precision can round away small changes to its diagonal entries. To mitigate this, Spool instead stores the residual D = A − I D=A-I , explicitly separating the identity component from the small deviations, better preserved in low precision, with the original state transition evaluated as S + S ​ D + B S+SD+B .

blocks.en: 3.4 Maintaining Windowed Attention State
blocks.zh: 3.4 保持窗口关注状态

blocks.en:
In addition to maintaining the recurrent state, Spool must efficiently update the attention key-value (KV) cache as video blocks expire.
Unlike recurrent layers, attention layers store individual token entries in fixed-size memory pages.
However, video blocks contain varying numbers of tokens, so expiring a block often leaves partially occupied KV pages that waste GPU memory or require a compaction step that introduces additional latency.
A second challenge is that attention assigns each new token a position index, which continues to increase as new video blocks arrive, even after older tokens expire. Over a long-running stream, these indices eventually exceed the model’s precomputed rotary position embedding (RoPE) table, which supports only a fixed range of positions.
blocks.zh:
除了保持经常性状态,Spool还必须在视频块过期时高效更新关注键值(KV)缓存.
与经常层不同,注意层在固定大小的内存页面中存储单个符号项.
然而,视频块包含不同数量的符号,因此过期时一个块往往会留下部分占用的KV页面,这些页面会浪费GPU的内存,或者需要引入额外耐久性的收缩步骤.
第二个挑战是,注意为每个新标志指定一个位置指数,该指数随着新的视频块的到来而继续增加,即使旧标志过期。 在一个长期流流中,这些指数最终超过了模型预算的旋转位置嵌入(ROPE)表,该表只支持固定位置范围.

blocks.en: Spool addresses these challenges with two mechanisms: (1) KV tail filling , which reclaims memory by moving surviving KV entries from the end of the cache into slots left by expired tokens, avoiding copies of the entire retained context; and (2) RoPE rebasing , which periodically shifts token positions and rotates cached keys to preserve attention outputs without recomputing retained tokens.
blocks.zh: Spool用两种机制来应对这些挑战: (1) KV尾补充,通过将幸存的 KV 条目从缓存末端移动到过期的代币留下的空档来恢复内存,避免了整个保留上下文的复制; (2) RoPE 重新定位,定期移动代币位置并旋转缓存密钥来保存注意输出而无需重算保留代币.

blocks.en: 3.4.1 KV tail filling
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 KV尾装填

blocks.en: To reclaim expired KV slots without shifting existing tokens, Spool uses tail filling to keep the cache dense. Importantly, existing KV entries do not have to maintain their original order because each key encodes its position. Therefore, assuming the keys and values are moved together, reordering the KV pairs therefore preserves the attention output in exact arithmetic. Spool exploits this property to fill expired slots with surviving KV pairs from the cache tail.
blocks.zh: 为了回收过期的 KV 插槽而无需移动现有的符号,Spool 使用尾部填充来保持缓存密度. 重要的是,现有的KV条目不需要维持其原始顺序,因为每个密钥编码其位置. 因此,假设键和值是一起移动的,重排KV对子,因此以精确的算术保留了注意力输出. Spool利用这个属性来填补过期的空档,从缓存尾端幸存的KV对.

blocks.en: Filling Expired Slots. To identify expired tokens after previous relocations, Spool maintains a mapping between tokens and their current KV slots. Suppose the cache contains n n tokens (including a fixed prefix) and the window advancement expires e e video tokens. The engine keeps the prefix unchanged and compacts the remaining KV entries into the first n − e n-e slots. For each expired slot in this range, it moves a surviving KV pair from the tail into the hole and updates the mapping (Fig. 5 , top). Expired entries already in the tail require no movement.
blocks.zh: 填满过期槽. 为了在之前的迁移后识别过期的令牌,Spool在令牌和它们目前的KV槽之间保持了映射. 如果缓存包含 n 个令牌(包括一个固定的前缀),而窗口推进则过期 e 视频令牌. 引擎保持前缀不变,并将剩余的KV条目压缩到第一个n − e n-e槽中. 对于这个范围内的每一个过期的槽,它会将一个幸存的KV对从尾部移动到洞中并更新映射(图5,顶部). 在尾部已经过期的条目不需要移动.

blocks.en: Copy Cost. Tail filling copies only the surviving KV pairs needed to fill expired slots. Let m m be the number of relocated tokens and b KV b_{\mathrm{KV}} the total KV payload per token across attention layers. Each relocation reads and writes one KV pair, giving a total copy cost of 2 ​ m ​ b KV 2mb_{\mathrm{KV}} bytes. Since each relocation fills one expired slot, m ≤ e m\leq e . Thus, the copy cost depends on the number of expired tokens rather than the length of the retained window.

blocks.en: Page Reclamation. After filling the expired slots, the engine reduces the sequence length to n − e n-e and releases pages entirely beyond this. Any partially filled final page remains allocated for subsequent tokens. The resulting cache is dense and can be used by existing prefill and decode kernels, without modifying the attention kernels.
blocks.zh: 页垦. 在填充过期的槽后,引擎将序列长度缩短到n - e n - e,并释放完全超出此范围的页面. 任何部分填充的最后一页仍为以后的符号。 由此产生的缓存是密集的,可以被现有的预填和解码内核使用,而不修改关注内核.

blocks.en: 4 Implementation
blocks.zh: 4 执行

blocks.en: We implement Spool in Python with PyTorch, Triton, and Flash Linear Attention, targeting hybrid VLMs. The runtime loads pretrained checkpoints and uses their Hugging Face processors for frame preparation and prompt construction.
blocks.zh: 我们用PyTorch,Triton,和Flash Linear 注意,在Python执行Spool,瞄准混合VLM. 运行时间加载预先训练的检查站,并使用它们的Hugging Face处理器进行帧制备和快速施工.

blocks.en: Recurrent kernels. We extend Flash Linear Attention’s chunked GDN prefill path to record block summaries from its existing intermediates. Custom Triton kernels construct residual summaries, merge tree nodes, and apply summaries to recurrent states. Merges and reconstruction batch independent layers and heads. Following the vLLM precision defaults, summaries use BF16 storage by default, while the prefix anchor and live recurrent state remain in FP32. State-transition products split the FP32 state into high and low BF16 components and accumulate both products in FP32.
blocks.zh: 经常性内核. 我们扩展了Flash Linear Reference的块式GDN预填路径,以记录其现有中间体的块摘要。 自定义 Triton内核构造剩余摘要,合并树节点,并将摘要应用到经常状态. 合并与重建批独立层和头. 在vLLM精密默认后,摘要默认使用BF16存储,而前缀锚和活的经常状态仍保留在FP32中. 国家过渡产品将FP32状态分为高低BF16成分,并在FP32中累积两种产品.

blocks.en: Attention cache. The cache stores BF16 keys and values in 256-token pages, using PyTorch’s paged variable-length attention for prefill and Triton kernels for decoding. For tail filling, the host translates the relocation plan through the page table into physical source and destination slots. A single Triton grid copies the selected entries across all attention layers and both keys and values. A separate kernel rebases cached keys using FP32 arithmetic before storing them in BF16.
blocks.zh: 注意缓存。 缓存将 BF16 密钥和值存储在 256 托肯 页面中,使用 PyTorch 的分页可变长注意值进行预填,以及 Triton 内核进行解码. 对于尾补,主机通过页面表将迁移计划翻译为物理源和目的地槽. 一个单一的Triton网格复制所有关注层和键和值的选定条目. 一个单独的内核再根据缓存密钥使用FP32算术,然后将其存储在BF16中.

Spool’s windowed state maintenance preserves the backbone’s answer quality: without timing pressure, it stays within − 1.6 -1.6 to + 1.8 +1.8 points of the more accurate baseline in each of the 24 tests and has the highest mean accuracy, 54.4% vs. 54.1% for vLLM-Incremental and 53.7% for vLLM-Omni. blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate Spool on six hybrid VLMs to assess scalability across model sizes and applicability across recurrent architectures.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评价Spool六种混合VLM,以评估不同模型大小的可扩展性和不同经常性结构的适用性。

blocks.en: Gated Delta Net (GDN) . We use the Qwen3.5 Qwen Team (2026) and Qwen3.6 families, whose hybrid backbones combine GDN with attention layers. We evaluate three dense variants (0.8B, 9B, and 27B) and two mixture-of-experts (MoE) variants (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B) to examine how Spool’s latency benefits and memory overhead vary across model sizes and configurations.
blocks.zh: Gated Delta Net (GDN) (英语). 我们使用Qwen3.5 Quen Team(2026)和Qwen3.6家族,他们的混合骨干结合了GDN和关注层. 我们评价三种密集的变体(0.8B、9B和27B)和两种专家混合变体(Qune3.6-35B-A3B和Qune3.5-122B-A10B),以审查Spool在模型大小和构型方面的耐久利益和内存间接费用如何不同。

blocks.en: State Space Model (SSM) . We use Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-VL NVIDIA (2025) , whose hybrid backbone combines attention with Mamba-2 Dao & Gu (2024) state-space layers. This model allows us to assess whether Spool’s approach to context window maintenance extends beyond GDN-based architectures.
blocks.zh: 州航天模型(SSM). 我们使用Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-VL NVIDIA (2025),其混合骨干结合了注意力与Mamba-2 Dao & Gu (2024)的状态空间层. 这个模型使我们能够评估Spool对上下文窗口维护的方法是否超越基于GDN的架构.

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate Spool on four complementary benchmarks covering general video understanding, long-context reasoning, rapidly changing scenes, and spatial memory relevant to embodied applications. For online evaluation (§ 5.2 ), we use the first five hours of each benchmark. For offline evaluation (§ 5.3 ), we use the full benchmarks, except for the 35B and 122B models, which use the first five hours due to limited GPU availability.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价Spool的四项补充基准,包括一般视频理解、长文推理、迅速变化的场景和与体现的应用有关的空间记忆。 对于在线评价(§5.2),我们使用每个基准的前5小时. 对于离线评价(§5.3),我们使用全部基准,除了35B型和122B型,由于GPU可用性有限,它们使用前5小时.

blocks.en: (1) StreamingBench Lin et al. (2024) evaluates streaming video understanding through multiple-choice questions. blocks.en: Metrics. We evaluate Spool in terms of inference efficiency and answer quality. For efficiency, we report time-to-first-token (TTFT), measured from query arrival to the first output token. For answer quality, we report results in both online and offline settings for each model–benchmark pair, using accuracy for multiple-choice tasks and benchmark-specific quality scores for open-ended tasks.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们从推断效率和回答质量的角度来评价Spool. 为了提高效率,我们报告从查询到达到第一个输出符号的按时到第一键(TTFT)。 关于答题质量,我们报告每个模型-基准对子的在线和离线设置结果,使用精确度来完成多选择任务,以及开放式任务的具体基准质量分数。

blocks.en: Hardware. In the online experiments, we use the smallest GPU available to us for each model. This is an A100 40 GB for Qwen3.5-9B and Nemotron-VL Nano-12B, a GH200 for Qwen3.5-27B, a B200 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and a B300 for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B. The memory ablation (Table 4 ) runs each model on one A100 40 GB GPU.
blocks.zh: 硬件。 在在线实验中,我们使用每个模型可用的最小GPU. 这是用于Quen3.5-9B和Nemotron-VL Nano-12B的A100 40 GB,用于Quen3.5-27B的GH200,用于Quen3.6-35B-A3B的B200,用于Quen3.5-122B-A10B的B300. 内存衰竭(表4)在一台A100 40 GB GPU上运行每个型号.

blocks.en: 5.2 Online Serving
blocks.zh: 5.2 在线服务

blocks.en: In the online setting, benchmark videos stream in real time. A client sends frames at wall-clock speed, with questions arriving at scheduled timestamps while frames continue to buffer. This tests a method’s accuracy and responsiveness under live compute and demand constraints. The server processes one question at a time following the given question time in the benchmark. If the system is currently busy, new questions are dropped rather than queued, penalizing slow methods with lost questions. Incoming frames, however, are never dropped and are buffered.
blocks.zh: 在在线设定中,实时的基准视频流. 一个客户端以壁时速发送帧,在帧继续缓冲的同时,问题按预定的时间戳到达. 在现场计算和需求制约下,这检验了一种方法的准确性和响应性。 服务器在基准中给定的提问时间之后每次处理一个问题. 如果系统目前繁忙,则会丢掉新的问题,而不是排队,用丢失的问题惩罚缓慢的方法. 然而,入境框架从未被放弃或缓冲。

blocks.en: Takeaways. Spool sharply shortens the latency tail (Table 1 ): it lowers p95 TTFT in all 20 tests by a geometric mean of 6.6 × 6.6\times over the faster baseline (up to 35.7 × 35.7\times ) and 33.8 × 33.8\times over vLLM-Omni, keeping p95 under 1 s in 16 of 20 tests versus 3 for incremental prefill. Because slow answers drop questions, this also raises accuracy (Table 2 ): Spool averages 52.8% versus 50.3% for incremental prefill, gaining up to 18.4 points on Beyond3D. Appendix D reports p50 TTFT (Table 5 ) and full TTFT CDFs (Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh: 外卖 Spool大幅缩短了潜伏尾巴(表1):在所有20个测试中,它将p95 TTFT降低,比更快的基准(最多35.7 × 35.7 时)高出6.6 × 6.6\时的几何平均值;在vLLM-Omni测试中,将p95保持在1 s以下,在20个测试中为16个,而增量预填时为3个。 由于答题缓慢,这也提高了准确性(表2): 斯普尔平均52.8%对50.3%的增量预填,在Beyond3D上获得最高18.4分. 附录D报告p50 TTFT(表5)和完整的TTFT CDF(图10)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Offline Answer Quality
blocks.zh: 5.3 离线回答质量

blocks.en: In the offline setting, the client sends all frames up to a question’s timestamp as fast as the server can ingest them, then pauses for the server’s answer before continuing. The server applies the same bounded frame window as in the online setting. This removes wall-clock constraints to isolate answer quality from streaming speed, ensuring accuracy differences stem solely from how each policy represents the video.
blocks.zh: 在离线设置中,客户端将所有帧发送到一个问题的时间戳上,快到服务器能摄取的时间戳,然后在继续前暂停服务器的答案. 服务器应用与在线设置相同的限定框窗口. 这消除了墙钟限制,将答题质量与流速隔离开来,确保准确性差异完全源于每个策略如何代表视频.

blocks.en: Takeaways. Without timing pressure, Spool matches baseline answer quality (Table 3 ): it stays within − 1.6 -1.6 to + 1.8 +1.8 points of the more accurate baseline in each of the 24 tests and has the highest mean accuracy, 54.4% versus 54.1% and 53.7%. Its small offline Beyond3D differences, against large online gains, indicate that the online advantage comes from answering on time.
blocks.zh: 外卖 在没有计时压力的情况下,Spool将基准答题质量(表3):它保持在−1.6-1.6至+1.8+1.8分以内,每24个测试中的基准更准确,平均准确度最高,为54.4%,54.1%和53.7%。 其微小的离线Beyond3D差异,与大型在线收益相比,表明在线优势来自于及时回答.

KV filling, added with the segment tree already enabled, lowers it by a further 2.9–5.6%, for a total reduction of 7.4–17.4%.

In contrast, with state reconstruction, the KL divergence stays roughly constant at about 0.04 as the window advances, showing that Spool’s approximation error is bounded rather than accumulating over time. This suggests state reconstruction matters most when a question depends on context the window has already discarded. Appendix B shows formally that when expired history hurts the current question, Spool without state reconstruction is strictly less accurate than Spool.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Reusing model state. SGLang and Marconi reuse matching prefixes, with Marconi also caching recurrent checkpoints ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024 ) . Tail-Replay approximates matched-prefix state from a short tail of cached attention outputs ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while CacheBlend selectively recomputes tokens to reuse non-prefix KV chunks ( Yao et al., 2024 ) . A recurrent checkpoint still incorporates expired blocks when the window’s left boundary advances. Spool instead composes all retained blocks’ cached transformations from the fixed prefix anchor. This preserves the full retained window’s recorded updates without replaying token activations.
blocks.zh: 重用模型状态. SGLang和Marconi再利用前缀匹配,Marconi还夹住经常检查站(郑等人,2024年;潘等人,2024年)。 Tail-Replay从短尾缓存的注意输出(Liu等人,2026年)中大致得出匹配-prefix状态,而CacheBlend则有选择地将符号重新计算为重复使用非prefix KV块(Yao等人,2024年). 当窗口左侧边界推进时,经常设置的检查站仍然包括过期的区块。 Spool 则由固定前缀主锚的所有保留块缓存转换组成 。 这保存了完整保留窗口的录制更新, 而无需重放符号激活 。

blocks.en: Recurrent composition and window aggregation. Affine composition underlies efficient Mamba and delta-rule kernels ( Gu & Dao, 2023 ; Dao & Gu, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . ReplaySSM caches recurrent inputs for decoding and speculative suffix rollback ( Liou et al., 2026 ) . HLA-WM also caches affine transformations without training, but recomposes history selected by camera geometry for video generation ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Associative window aggregation is established in stream processing, including Reactive Aggregator’s trees and DABA’s constant-time FIFO operations ( Tangwongsan et al., 2015 ; Tangwongsan et al., 2017 ) . Spool instead maintains the recent video window by caching interval compositions in a segment tree as the oldest blocks expire.
blocks.zh: 经常性组成和窗口汇总。 Affine组成是高效的曼巴和三角规则内核的基础(Gu & Dao, 2023; Dao & Gu, 2024; Yang等人, 2024; Yang等人, 2025)。 重放SSM缓存用于解码和投机后缀回滚的经常性输入(Liou等人,2026年). HLA-WM亦不经过训练就缓存affine变换,但重新编译由相机几何选择的历史,用于视频生成(Chen等人,2026年). 在溪流处理中建立了关联窗口聚合,包括反应聚合器的树和DABA的常时FIFO操作(Tangwongsan等人,2015年;Tangwongsan等人,2017年). 在最古老的区块到期时,Spool通过切换区段树上的间隔组成来维持最近的视频窗口。

blocks.en: Streaming video inference. StreamingVLM and InfiniteVL adapt training or attention structure for long inputs ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Tao et al., 2025 ) , while Video DeltaNet targets video generation with hybrid recurrent attention ( Xi et al., 2026 ) . Training-free methods compress or retrieve video KV ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Di et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) ; SimpleStream demonstrates competitive recent-frame windows ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . KV retention alone leaves recurrent history unchanged. Spool reconstructs recurrent state after expiry on a pretrained hybrid backbone without further training.
blocks.zh: 流传视频推论. StreamingVLM和InfiniteVL调整培训或关注结构,用于长投入(徐等人,2026年;陶等人,2025年),而Video DeltaNet则以混合反复关注的视频生成为目标(习近平等人,2026年). 无训练方法压缩或检索视频 KV(Zhang等人,2026a;Di等人,2025;Chen等人,2025b);SimpleStream显示近期窗体具有竞争力 (沈等,2026). 单是保留KV,经常发生的情况就保持不变。 斯普尔在经过预先训练的混合骨干上,在期满后重建了反复状态,没有经过进一步训练.

blocks.en: Memory selection and storage. StreamingLLM, H 2 O, and SnapKV retain sink, recent, or important KV entries ( Xiao et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . DeltaS and GateSight use recurrent-state signals for KV selection ( Kwon et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , while DAMP compresses recurrent states with mixed precision ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . PagedAttention and OPKV manage allocation and recall ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Lao et al., 2026 ) . Spool instead reconstructs recurrent state after expiry, excluding expired blocks’ recorded updates from each layer.
blocks.zh: 内存选择与存储. 流体LM, H2 O, 和 SnapKV 保留了最近的或重要的KV条目(Xiao等人, 2023年;Zhang等人, 2023年;Li等人, 2024年)。 德尔塔 S和GateSight在KV选择时使用反复状态信号(Kwon等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年),而DAMP则以混合精度压缩反复状态(Zhang等人,2026年b). PagedAttention和OPKV管理分配和召回(Kwon等人,2023年;Lao等人,2026年). Spool 代替在过期后重建重复状态, 不包括每个层中已过期的块记录的更新 。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Hybrid VLMs need to expire old frames without replaying retained context.
Spool does so without retraining through cached affine transformations, segment tree reconstruction, and KV tail filling.
Across five VLMs and four benchmarks, it achieves the lowest p95 TTFT in all 20 model–benchmark tests, with a geometric mean speedup of 6.6 × 6.6\times , and an average online accuracy gain of 2.3 percentage points, each against the stronger baseline for that metric.
blocks.zh:
Hybrid VLMs需要过期的旧帧而不重放保留上下文.
Spool没有通过缓存的芳香变换,段树重建,以及KV尾装填来进行再培训.
在五个VLM和四个基准中,它在所有20个模型-基准测试中都实现了最低的p95 TTFT,几何平均速度为6.6×6.6\时,在线平均准确度提高2.3个百分点,每点都比该度量的更强基线高。

Spool still has the lowest or tied-lowest p50 in 18 of 20 tests ( 1.9 × 1.9\times geometric mean over the faster baseline, 32.2 × 32.2\times over vLLM-Omni), with the largest gap on FastBench with Nemotron-VL Nano-12B (0.14 s vs. 2.66 s). vLLM-Incremental is marginally faster on StreamingBench with Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, by 0.01–0.02 s. Parentheses: speedup over the faster baseline.
blocks.zh: 表5:在线p50 TTFT(s, \\ downarrow ). 斯普尔的潜伏优势集中在尾部:vLLM-Incremental快速地回答典型的问题,但对于一个占其p95(表1)优势的少数人来说却陷入了停滞. 在20个测试中,Spool在18个测试中仍然拥有最低或最低的p50(1.9 × 1.9\时的几何平均值高于更快的基准,32.2×32.2\时的数值高于vLLM-Omni),与Nemotron-VL Nano-12B(0.14 s vs 2.66 s)在Fast Bench上差距最大. vLLM-增量在流奔车(Quen3.5-27B和Quen3.5-122B-A10B)上速度略快,比0.01-0.02秒快。
